patches_modified.name: Block Vivaldi Sync
patches_modified.description: Redirects bifrost.vivaldi.com to 0.0.0.0 in libchrome.so to completely disable Vivaldi account synchronization for an air-gapped experience.

patches_modified.name: Block Vivaldi Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks Vivaldi usage statistics, crash reporting, Crashpad endpoints, and DirectMatch suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Clean Speed Dial Bookmarks
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored commercial affiliate bookmarks, hides the 3-dot customize button, and disables phantom touch actions on the blank Start Page.

patches_modified.name: Close Tabs on Exit
patches_modified.description: Prevents tab restoration on startup, ensuring Vivaldi always opens with a clean Start Page session regardless of how the app was terminated.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by neutralizing periodic and one-shot background sync tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Android BatteryStatusManager broadcast listener to prevent continuous OS battery wakeups.

patches_modified.name: Disable Chromium Tips & Notification Scheduler
patches_modified.description: Eliminates periodic background wakeups, native library loading, and in-product promotional tips from Chromium tips scheduler.

patches_modified.name: Disable Vivaldi Prompts & In-App Popups
patches_modified.description: Disables in-app donation prompts, search engine switch promos, rate-app popups, background privacy report alarms, and default browser promotional handlers.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches_modified.name: Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips bundled stock wallpapers and sponsored Speed Dial thumbnails to reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches_modified.name: Vivaldi Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes cold startup time, eliminates background CPU/disk overhead, and guards against early CompositorView LayoutStateObserver crashes.

patches_modified.name: Shadow Fight 2 IAP Bypass (Smali)
patches_modified.description: Bypasses in-app purchases via smali patching. Intercepts zzbm callbacks to inject fake purchase data into C++ layer.

patches_modified.name: Clean Me Tab
patches_modified.description: WARNING: MX Player has an integrity check, and some mods add their own on top. Use a Play Store build, patch with signing off, then strip signature verification (MT Manager Enhanced or a modded build) - or the app may refuse to start.Removes promo rows and unused tiles from the Me tab. Optional Add Network Stream tile.

patches_modified.name: Configure Smart Enhance
patches_modified.description: Configures the Smart Enhance intro popup and enable/disable toast.

patches_modified.name: Configure SpeedUp overlay
patches_modified.description: "2x UI": keeps the long-press SpeedUp overlay/animation, with the stock leftover-visible-view bug fixed. "No UI": the overlay never shows at all - the speed change itself still applies, since that's handled elsewhere.

patches_modified.name: Disable Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top
patches_modified.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar and adds a Me tab button to the toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Sidebar & Player Defaults
patches_modified.description: Cleans the player sidebar and More menu; sets default shortcuts and subtitle view.
